features: Bundle deterministic third-party dependency license and notice records in Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel packages.
fixes: Fetch the complete locked Cargo source union before strict offline notice generation on every packaging runner.
Reject release packages whose embedded notice resource is missing, altered, incomplete or still pending review.
Restore the native application icon in packaged bundles and verify its exact macOS resource bytes and bundle metadata.
limitations: Windows installers are unsigned. macOS bundles have ad-hoc signatures, not Developer ID signatures or notarization; operating-system security checks may block launch.
Native macOS first-launch and installer lifecycle testing remain pending. Image validation does not certify application behavior.
Git is required for repository inspection. No automatic updater is provided.
The AI-assisted dependency notice review and package-content assertions are bounded engineering evidence, not legal clearance.
